messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Question
parts:
The form of model fitted to your data, consequently the adjustment terms=20
employed is a function of the data collected. It will not be a matter of=20
fitting a single model to your data, but rather, you will fit a set of=20
models to your data, and use model selection procedures, such as AIC to=20
select the most appropriate model from among the models you fit to your=20
data. I suggest you consult the following sections of Buckland et al.=20
(2001): Introduction to distance sampling: Section 2.5 (some analysis=20
guidelines) and Section 4.6 (model selection of line transect data).
